is fully implemented, India's criminal justice system will become the most modern in the
world. He said after full implementation of the BNS, cases could be disposed of within
three years from the registration of an FIR to the Supreme Court. Mr. Shah said
this while addressing the state-level Gaupalak Summelan in Bhopal today.
After the full implementation of the law, our criminal justice system will become the most
modern criminal justice system in the world.
Within this law, we have incorporated science, online hearings, videoconferencing, provisions
for FSL and linked many modern scientific advancements.
There are arrangements for protection against all these issues, including women's safety,
missing children, terrorism and lynching.
All BJP MLAs from Haryana along with Chief Minister Naib Singh said he met Prime Minister
Narendra Modi in New Delhi.
In a social media post, the Prime Minister said during the meeting he had a meaningful
dialogue with them on several topics.
weeks. He said discussion was also held on serving the people in the best possible manner

In Andhra Pradesh, four workers were killed and another was critically injured in a boiler
explosion at a private industrial unit in Sree city of Satyavedu, Mandel today. The blast
occurred inside a factory in the special economic zone. Two workers died on the spot while
three others were critically injured and shifted to a nearby hospital. Two of the injured
later succumbed to their injuries during treatment.
The remaining worker is undergoing treatment in the intensive care unit.
Chief Minister Enchantre Babu Naidu expressed shock over the incident.
A high-level central team has arrived in Bengaluru today to assess the drought situation in
Karnataka, led by Joint Secretary in the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare.
Ajit Kumar Saho, the team will tour the drought-affected regions till October 6th.
Divided into three teams, they will visit
Tumkuru, Chitradurga, Dhawanagere, Balarri, Mysore,
Uchama, Rajanagar, Mandya, Yadgi, Rai Chod,
Bagelkot and Koppel to assess the crop loss and distress
faced by the farmers in the drought affected regions.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is completing 25 years
in public service, a journey defined by the mantra
of Janseva, said Deshseva, and a relentless commitment
government that continues. Guided by this vision for Seva and Sushasen, the government
has been ceaselessly working towards achieving the goal of a Vikasit Bharat by 2047. Through
inclusive development and social empowerment, this dedication is transforming lives. Today
in our special series, we bring you an instance of how this vision has been translated
into the new parliament building and Central Vista.
The Central Vista redevelopment project is a massive master plan to redesign India's
Central Administrative and Civic Core in Delhi. Its key components include new parliament
building, Kartavya Path and common central secretariat. The objective is to improve
the productivity and efficiency of administration by providing it with highly functional and
purpose-designed office infrastructure. Combining all 51 central government ministries
in 10 common central secretariat buildings will allow for easy movement of personnel,
documents and goods. The new parliament house was inaugurated on 28th May 2023 by Prime Minister
Narendra Modi. Materials for the new parliament house were drawn from across the states under
the Aik Bharat-Shrisht Bharat idea. The building now holds the single that marks the transfer
of authority. The building has six entrances named after my philological creatures,
Gajah, Ashwa, Garuda, Makara, Shardula and Hamsa.
Inoculating the new parliament house, Prime Minister Modi said, it is not merely a building,
but is a reflection of the aspirations and dreams of 140 crore Indians.

Ukraine has described India's proposal for a possible ceasefire with Russia as the broadest
among four offers received by Kyiv, with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrei Saviha saying
it is ready to consider a truce covering energy infrastructure and the Black Sea.
The Russia-Ukraine war, now in its fifth year, has killed thousands of civilians, displaced
millions and caused widespread destruction of homes and critical infrastructure.
External Affairs Minister Dr S. Jaishankar today chaired a consultative committee meeting
on India-Russia relations in New Delhi.
During the meeting, Dr Jaishankar highlighted various aspects of India's multifaceted
engagement, including in trade, investments, energy, connectivity, culture, and P2P domains.
In a social media post, the external Affairs Minister said he also highlighted India's active
support to dialogue and diplomacy to end the Ukraine conflict.
The Embassy of India in Oman coordinated the rescue of five Indian nationals onboard
the Kuwait-flagged tanker M. T. Kazima III struck by a projectile in the Strait
of Hormuz.
In a social media post, the embassy said all five Indian nationals have been shifted
ashore safely.
It thanked Omani authorities for their continued support and assistance.
The Ministry of Education has approved five centres of excellence for studies in classical
languages.
Department of Higher Education has approved the establishment of the five centres of
excellence for studies in classical asemes, classical Bengali, classical Marathi, classical
Pali and Classical Prakrit. The initiative will provide dedicated institutional support
for advanced academic research, preservation and digitization of linguistic and literary
heritage, and wider dissemination of knowledge relating to these classical languages.
An Indian parliamentary delegation led by the Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha Hariwant
has departed for Tanzania to participate in the 153rd Assembly of the Inter-Parliamentary
Union, IPU and related meetings being held from the 5th to the 9th of this month.
The delegation will participate in a wide range of meetings, panel discussions and workshops
on issues of contemporary global relevance and articulate India's perspectives on these
matters.
India won five gold, two silver and two bronze medals at the Asian Games in Japan today.
In Hockey, India thrashed Malaysia 5-1 to defend their men's gold, and the triumph also
secured them a direct qualification for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.
For India, Captain Herman Preet Singh netted two golds while Jyugraj Hardik and Shilanand
scored one gold each.
In men's cricket, India won the gold, defeating arch rivals Pakistan by 19 runs
in the T20 final at Nishin.
Ressler Aman Seh Rawat clinched the men's 57 kilogram gold after edging out North Korea's
world champion, Chong Song Han, 11-7 in a fierce final.
Kumkum Mahod won the individual gold medal in the Women's Recurve archery event.
In golf, Pranavi Urs became the first Indian woman to win an Asian Games gold medal in
the women's individual title.
Inder also backed silver in the team event.

Kunia won bronze in the men's 97 kilogram freestyle wrestling event after defeating

recurve event. With these impressive performances in their climb to fourth position in the
overall medal standings, the country's medal tally has risen to 85, including
including 21 gold, 27 silver and 37 bronze medals.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the men's cricket team on retaining their title
at the Asian Games 2026 in a series of social media posts.
Mr Modi said this is indeed a joyous occasion for the nation.
He also wished the team members for their future endeavours.
Mr Modi said that 2026 Asian Games have been truly special for Indian hockey.
he congratulated the men's hockey team on retaining the Asian Games gold with a

The Intermittological Department, IMD, has forecast heavy rainfall at isolated places
over Kerala, Mahi, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karayakal for tomorrow. IMD said conditions
are likely to become favourable for further withdrawal of southwest monsoon from remaining
parts of Maratwara and with some more parts of Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Telangana and
north interior Karnataka during the next two days.
